completedTasks.title: Update-check extension hooking pi update to integration releases
completedTasks.summary: New update-check extension (core matrix + session_start wiring + /update-check status|check, TDD 24 tests; full suite 973: 967 pass/6 skip). Honest scope: pi exposes no update lifecycle event, so no hook into pi update exists; notify-only release check instead (never auto-installs), pi version unchecked by doc. publish.ts ships the dir + writes atomic installed marker outside owned dirs. v1.0.0 tagged+released; published to user scope, check in sync; live API matrix verified (stale->update, current->silent, no-marker->guidance, offline->silent). Landed via branch:main push to avoid clobbering another session's uncommitted chain-reorder on the main checkout.
decisions: Notify-only over auto-install: update mutates user scope, needs a human
Marker outside owned extension dir: --check exact-set equality must never see per-install state
Scheduled handler returns (not floats) the check promise: fixes test/shutdown race, real timers ignore it
In-session plan+implementation review, reduced rigor noted: evidence-led design, TDD RED-first, gates green

completedTasks.title: Queue-only admission, /monitors command, structured delegation results + result cache
completedTasks.summary: Delegate admission repaired to the ruled run-now rule (registry.start -> admitRequest: one-element serial group in the ONE queue; admits iff a slot is free and the queue head is not slot-blocked — cap full, mid-flight serial heads, unfittable parallel heads queue; delegations wait tool action REMOVED, the monitor wait tool is the only waiting surface; stale wait-verb text driven to zero incl. grep-invisible docstring). Monitor: /monitors command (armed panel id/name/excerpt/age/time-left, cancel <id> via gate-skipping internals, headless silent no-op, completions) and the poll guard now counts the delegations results action (list|log|results). Subagent: in-memory result cache (ring of last 8, dual-indexed by delegation_id and parent_id, eviction/duplicate/parent-omission hygiene, injected-clock timestamps, char caps 120/2000/6000 with head/tail markers) wired at the deliverNote entry before the 2s batch window; structured results ride every card (details.result single, details.notes[i].result batched); delegations results [id] action with registry-disambiguated misses. Versions subagent 1.2.0, monitor 1.1.0. High-effort: plan-review MoE (2 experts, READY-WITH-FOLDS, 9 musts folded), two disjoint lanes (A subagent / B monitor) merged clean, implementation MoE (3 experts, triple SHIP, zero musts), QA review-tests GATE: BLOCKED cleared (mutation-proven aborted-note wiring row + rejection-redirect pins). 771 tests green (765 pass, 6 gated skips), typecheck clean.
